title: Vapor Deluxe Daddy Box Vaporizer (taxes extra)
description:
Deluxe Daddy Whip Vaporizer
AKA: Vapor Daddy Deluxe

GOT A FEW MORE, LIMITED QUANTITIES

REPLACEMENT HEATERS IN STOCK

TV-W11 SCREEN PACKS IN STOCK
TV-W11 REPLACED BY ELEV8 FATTY WHIP
ELEV8 FATTY WHIP SCREENS AVAILABLE

The Daddy Deluxe vaporizer is based on the box whip design, it has all the basic features you need. Glass parts, basic temperature control, easy to use whip and a solid box case to hold everything.

Features:
Ceramic Heating Element
Glass on Glass
Removable/Replaceable Heater Cover
Removable/Replaceable Heating Element
On/Off Switch
Numbered Temp Dial
Aroma Cup
Silicon Tubing
Comes in Multiple Colors

No longer being made, limited warranty support
We do have parts and will continue to supply whips and screens.

Important note: As with all box vaporizers, we recommend a burn in time of 20-30 minutes without inhaling before use.
